brands.name: moss
brands.description: A quiet, restorative identity for a botanical skincare studio. Generous negative space meets a sculptural leaf and an unexpectedly fresh chartreuse.
brands.heading: manrope
rules: Keep the leaf upright and give it half its height in clear space.
Use forest for text; new leaf is a supporting surface, never small text on oat.
Let the oversized mark crop at the edge of photography or packaging.

system.concept: Sculptural herbarium silhouettes, apothecary labels, and expansive forest-green fields. The warmth comes from material, not decorative clutter.
headline: Nature, in
your nature.
features: Rooted in something real
Plant-led formulas with a purposeful place in your daily ritual.
Less, thoughtfully
A smaller collection. A clearer intention. Every ingredient belongs.
A softer daily ritual
Good care is a practice, not a promise of perfection.
system.layoutNote: Forest hero; left-aligned, two-line display; a large botanical image occupies the right half. Cream product cards follow a 3-column desktop / 1-column mobile grid.

brands.name: orbit
brands.description: An exploratory identity for a collaborative ideas platform. Orbital geometry, lilac space, and wide-set typography create a world that feels one step ahead.
brands.heading: space-grotesk
rules: Orbit rings stay at a 28-degree inclination.
Use lilac as the primary canvas and deep space for the wordmark.
Keep interface components rounded while display layouts remain open.

system.concept: Luminous orbital objects and precise flight-path diagrams meet a playful digital interface. Rounded controls live inside disciplined, spacious technical frames.
headline: Your next idea.
A new orbit.
system.eyebrow: A WORKSPACE FOR WHAT COMES NEXT
features: Make space
Collect the fragments that could become your next great idea.
Connect the dots
Bring your thinking together in a workspace that stays open.
Build with others
Good ideas get better when they have somewhere to meet.
system.layoutNote: Lilac split hero with oversized orbital artwork. The second section uses bordered, offset cards and coral only as a small decorative highlight.

brands.name: SORA
brands.description: A considered identity for a light-led architecture practice. A blue doorway, measured capitals, and a strict alignment system give every application room to breathe.
brands.heading: outfit
rules: Align the arch opening to the baseline of the wordmark.
Set headings in spaced capitals and body copy in sentence case.
Build compositions on an eight-column grid with wide outside margins.

system.concept: Monolithic apertures, isometric architectural studies, and rigorously spaced type. Every application treats light and negative space as building materials.
headline: Spaces for
a different light.
features: Begin with the light
A considered approach to how a space feels throughout the day.
Material honesty
Form and texture chosen for their place, purpose, and longevity.
Room to breathe
Measured spaces that leave enough room for real life.
system.layoutNote: An airy white architectural hero. Use an 8-column feeling, tracked uppercase labels, a wide right-hand image, and numbered project rows instead of bubbly UI.

brands.name: OFFSCRIPT
brands.description: A rule-bending system for an independent creative studio. A cut-paper asterisk, electric orange, and deliberately displaced type make it impossible to ignore.
brands.heading: archivo
brands.voice: Direct, irreverent, and full of conviction.
rules: Keep the asterisk sharp; do not round its ends.
Oversized type may break the grid, but utility text must align precisely.
Use hot orange as a dominant surface, paired only with ink for text.

system.concept: Offset print, torn geometric registrations, oversized compressed headlines, and high-visibility orange. The chaos is deliberate; the information is exact.
headline: Good ideas
break the format.
features: A sharper idea
Start with a position worth taking, then make it unmistakable.
A louder language
Graphic systems with enough conviction to carry the message.
Built to break through
Useful, working design that does more than sit politely.
system.layoutNote: Orange poster-scale hero with hard grid rules, black rectangular CTA, and a cropped print graphic. Never soften the composition into rounded SaaS cards.

brands.name: bloom
brands.description: An exuberant identity for everyday objects that make people smile. Rounded petals, juicy coral, and soft lilac turn a small moment into something memorable.
brands.heading: bricolage
brands.voice: Sunny, conversational, and a little cheeky.
rules: Petals may rotate as a group, but their proportions never change.
Mix two pastel surfaces per layout with berry as the text anchor.
Use pill-shaped labels as playful annotations, not primary headings.

system.concept: Oversized sculpted petals, candy-colored packaging, and friendly heavy lettering. Playfulness appears in a few big gestures, balanced by very readable details.
headline: Good things
have room to bloom.
features: A brighter everyday
Objects that make the ordinary moments feel a little less ordinary.
Made to be kept
Good form, useful function, and personality that lasts.
Room for your own way
A collection to mix, match, and make part of your world.
system.layoutNote: Centered coral hero, rounded petal artwork below the headline, wide cream pill CTAs, and alternating lilac / vanilla product tiles. Keep the berry text anchor.

brands.name: AUREL
brands.tagline: The art of taking your time.
brands.description: A warm, cultivated identity for a small hotel with a big sense of place. A radiating sun seal, a refined serif, and wine-colored details suggest understated luxury.
brands.heading: cormorant
rules: The sun seal sits above the wordmark, never inside it.
Reserve gilded for ornaments and spacious surfaces; use bordeaux for body text.
Pair large serif headings with very small, tracked sans-serif labels.

system.concept: A contemporary sun medallion, engraved-looking hairlines, linen-colored stationery, and generous serif setting. The system feels like a beautifully kept personal invitation.
headline: A place to stay.
A reason to linger.
features: Rooms with a rhythm
Thoughtful spaces, warm materials, and time to settle in.
A table to remember
Seasonal pleasures and the simple grace of eating well.
A sense of place
Stay close to the neighborhood, and a little closer to yourself.
system.layoutNote: Linen hero, centered high-contrast serif, a small sun seal, and a framed courtyard image. Bordeaux fine borders; gold appears as ornament, never small reading text.

brands.name: fieldwork
brands.description: A practical outdoor identity inspired by contour maps and trail journals. Rugged olive, rust, and a horizon mark connect useful gear to the places it goes.
brands.heading: work-sans
brands.voice: Resourceful, observant, and down to earth.
rules: Use contour lines as full-bleed backgrounds at low visual density.
Keep the horizon mark horizontal even on angled applications.
Give product specifications mono typography and clearly separated rows.

system.concept: Layered survey maps, trail-equipment details, and small expedition labels. A rich landscape carries the warmth of worn canvas and useful things.
headline: There is more
out there.
features: Built for outside
Honest equipment for the places a screen cannot take you.
Observe a little closer
Field notes that make familiar landscapes feel new again.
Take only what helps
A focused collection of objects with a job to do.
system.layoutNote: Dark canvas split hero, topo landscape, rust annotation chips, and numbered, mono-captioned equipment cards. A utility rhythm rather than decorative wellness softness.

brands.name: neue
brands.description: A restrained digital identity built around a folded N and a cool mineral palette. Every line has a job; every layout prioritizes clarity over decoration.
brands.heading: dm-sans
rules: The folded N is always filled, never outlined.
Use a single accent per interface view and maintain strong neutral hierarchy.
Align all headings to the same vertical axis across a page.

system.concept: Folded aluminum-like surfaces, disciplined neutral typography, and modular documentation. Contrast, alignment, and sequence create the entire visual language.
headline: A clearer way
to get things done.
features: One clear place
A modular workspace that puts the useful things first.
Less to get around
Thoughtful defaults and a hierarchy that makes sense.
More room to focus
A quiet interface that lets the work do the talking.
system.layoutNote: White, left-aligned product hero with an alloy-fold image. Restrained 8px cards, 1px dividers, one mineral accent, and clear numerical hierarchy.

brands.name: Paloma
brands.description: A literary identity with a distinctive paper-bird emblem. Mustard yellow and midnight blue frame a graceful serif, bringing an independent press to life.
brands.heading: lora
rules: Let the bird point toward the reading direction.
Use marigold for covers and midnight for all long-form reading text.
Set excerpts with generous leading and a visible opening margin.

system.concept: Cut-paper flight, book-cover rhythm, drop-cap-like display typography, and a rich mustard-and-ink palette. A literary world with a contemporary editorial edge.
headline: Stay for
the story.
features: A voice of their own
Work chosen for its character, care, and unmistakable perspective.
Books as objects
Considered paper, good typography, and room for the words.
A conversation that lasts
Stories to return to, pass on, and keep close.
system.layoutNote: A paper editorial hero with serif display and a yellow book-jacket image. Hairline columns, large reading margins, and clearly separated editorial metadata.

brands.name: goodkind
brands.tagline: A little good goes a long way.
brands.description: A generous identity for a neighborhood mutual-aid collective. A smiling loop, surprising tomato red, and friendly typography make participation feel easy.
brands.heading: rubik
rules: The smile remains open at the top; do not turn it into a closed badge.
Write calls to action in everyday language and sentence case.
Use lavender and tomato in separate blocks, with plum linking the layout.

system.concept: Embracing shapes, riso-style overprinting, neighborhood notices, and welcoming rounded lettering. Warmth comes from the sense that many people belong here.
headline: A little good.
A lot of together.
system.productNote: Something good to be part of.
features: Start close to home
Small, useful actions that begin with the people around you.
Make room for others
A community that gets better with every different perspective.
Keep the good going
Share an idea, a skill, a little time, or a helping hand.
system.layoutNote: Lavender hero with embracing forms, plum headings, and tomato event panels below. Friendly pill controls; readable event information always stays on a calm surface.

brands.name: RELAY
brands.description: A high-energy identity for real-time infrastructure. A stepped signal, acid yellow, and compact technical typography communicate speed without visual clutter.
brands.heading: unbounded
rules: Use the three-step signal at fixed proportions.
Acid yellow carries action; terminal carries technical detail.
Number modules and keep specification labels in monospaced capitals.

system.concept: Oscilloscope ribbons, precise terminal frames, numbered modules, and sharply electric signal color. A technical world with unmistakable speed and editorial discipline.
headline: Keep your ideas
moving forward.
features: Always in sync
A clear foundation for information that keeps moving.
Useful at every layer
Technical detail organized around the job you need to do.
A signal worth following
Purposeful tools, legible interfaces, and fewer unnecessary steps.
system.layoutNote: Terminal-black hero with acid-yellow type and waveform art. Numbered modules, monospaced labels, 3px corners, and rectangular controls. No candy gradients or floating cards.

brands.name: Sundaze
brands.description: A nostalgic identity for a neighborhood coffee-and-soda bar. A rising sun, warm apricot stripes, and a delightfully soft serif bring the slow weekend to every day.
brands.heading: fraunces
rules: Keep sunrise bands parallel and evenly spaced.
Use roast for text on apricot or cream soda surfaces.
Give headline typography a soft curve through generous spacing, not distortion.

system.concept: Warm screenprint sunsets, scalloped café labels, striped cups, and deeply rounded vintage type. A coherent coffee-and-soda world with real packaging personality.
headline: Good coffee.
No particular hurry.
system.eyebrow: COFFEE / SODA / THE SLOW GOOD STUFF
features: Your usual, made well
A familiar pleasure with room for a new favorite.
The slow good stuff
Good ingredients, unhurried care, and warm company.
Stay a little longer
A neighborhood table for mornings that become afternoons.
system.layoutNote: Apricot centered hero, soft chunky serif, a broad sunny illustration, and roast-colored rounded outlined controls. Cream menu tiles and simple stripes, not modern glass cards.

brands.name: onda
brands.description: A fluid identity for a coastal movement studio. Hand-drawn wave geometry, ocean blue, and cloud-white surfaces create a calm but active visual rhythm.
brands.heading: urbanist

Allow organic bands to flow off both sides of the canvas.
Use sea glass for generous background areas, not paragraph text.

system.concept: Tidal contours, folded wave ribbons, sea-glass translucency, and airy movement typography. The composition alternates still reading areas with broad flowing graphics.
headline: Move with
your own rhythm.
system.productNote: Make a little room for movement.
features: Begin where you are
A practice that makes space for your own pace.
Find a natural rhythm
Movement, breath, and consistency over perfection.
Return to the moment
A calm, thoughtful place to connect with yourself.
system.layoutNote: Foam-white hero with sea-glass tidal art, a wide text-to-image gutter, and shell-colored section annotations. Rounded movement cards are balanced by open space.

brands.name: Elsewhere
brands.description: An evocative identity for thoughtful travel journals. A doorway into another world, pale persimmon, and an expressive serif invite people to take the scenic route.
brands.heading: instrument-serif
rules: The doorway is a window, so leave its center visually open.
Frame photography with a generous postcard border.
Use large serif headlines and small, uppercase location captions.

system.concept: Surreal doorways into layered landscapes, postcard framing, beautifully oversized reading serifs, and destination-like color blocks. Travel as a point of view.
headline: There is another
way to be away.
system.eyebrow: JOURNEYS WITH A POINT OF VIEW
system.productNote: Go slowly. Look a little closer.
features: The scenic approach
A journey shaped by curiosity rather than a checklist.
Places with a story
Thoughtful notes on what makes somewhere feel different.
Time to notice
More room for the moments between the destinations.
system.layoutNote: Warm postcard hero with oversized expressive serif and a framed persimmon portal. Use running location captions, inset imagery, and a calm left-aligned reading rhythm.

brands.name: FORMHAUS
brands.description: A structural identity for a furniture workshop. Intersecting beams, a deep ultramarine, and a strict modular grid make the construction itself the visual language.
brands.heading: syne
rules: Build all graphic frames from the same beam thickness.
Let ultramarine dominate with plywood as the counterweight.
Keep titles flush left and attach measurements to visible grid lines.

system.concept: Isometric furniture studies, exposed joins, ultramarine structural frames, and expanded industrial type. Nothing disguises how the system is put together.
headline: Good form.
Built from the inside.
features: Construction first
Objects whose structure is also their character.
Material, honestly
Useful forms made with respect for what they are made from.
A place in real life
Design that earns its space by being used.
system.layoutNote: Ultramarine structural hero with plywood light type and isometric joinery. A visible modular grid, square frames, dimension-like labels, and full-width object rows.

brands.name: velour
brands.description: A tactile identity for a slow-fashion label. A looping ribbon, soft blush, and precise charcoal wordmarks balance romantic detail with a contemporary silhouette.
brands.heading: prata

Use rouge as a tiny editorial punctuation rather than a full background.
Keep garment information quiet and never track body paragraphs.

system.concept: Sculptural folded ribbons, couture-like labels, blush tissue, and quietly dramatic serif setting. Sensory material meets precise contemporary composition.
headline: Extraordinary,
in the everyday.
features: Feel the difference
Form, texture, and the little details closest to you.
A slower approach
Pieces made with care and room to become familiar.
Wear your own way
A quiet foundation for a very personal point of view.
system.layoutNote: Centered silk-white hero with a narrow high-contrast serif and a wide blush ribbon image. Quiet product captions and fine rules; rouge is a small punctuation only.

brands.name: kinfolk
brands.description: A generous identity for a local produce pantry. A growing sprout, butter-yellow paper, and an honest serif connect familiar food with the people who grow it.
brands.heading: fraunces
rules: The sprout grows upward with a visible stem.
Use butter labels with olive text on natural packaging.
Treat ingredient lists as a key part of the design, not fine print.

system.concept: Hand-cut produce silhouettes, seed diagrams, honest food labels, and a warm bookish serif. Seasonal abundance sits inside orderly, useful information design.
headline: Good things grow
close to home.
system.eyebrow: A SEASONAL PANTRY / A SHARED TABLE
features: Seasonal by nature
A collection that follows what is good right now.
Know the ground
A closer connection to the people and places that grow your food.
Bring it to the table
Simple, generous things for the way you actually eat.

brands.name: modo
brands.description: A clear identity for a small-business finance tool. Interlocking modules and a single decisive cobalt accent create a system that feels both trustworthy and approachable.
brands.heading: manrope
rules: Keep a one-module gap between the two halves of the symbol.
Use cobalt for active elements, with ledger for long-form text.
Align numerical values to the right and use consistent decimal precision.

system.concept: Folded modular M geometry, confident cobalt interfaces, and meticulous financial hierarchy. The expressive graphic system never obscures numerical information.
headline: A little more clarity.
A lot more possibility.
system.eyebrow: A BETTER VIEW OF YOUR BUSINESS
features: See what matters
A considered hierarchy that makes important information clear.
Stay in control
Useful workflows that keep the everyday details together.
Make room to grow
A trustworthy foundation for the next part of your business.
system.layoutNote: White finance hero with cobalt modular illustration. Ledger text for long reading, aligned numeric rows, and calm 10px card corners. Avoid decorative low-contrast data.

brands.name: juno
brands.description: A lively identity for an independent accessories label. Four offset dots, violet blocks, and a confident rounded wordmark celebrate personal expression without taking it too seriously.
brands.heading: outfit

Let violet and limeade meet at hard-edged background divisions.
Use oversized lowercase words and short, friendly supporting lines.

system.concept: Asymmetric color orbs, editorial cutouts, highly rounded lettering, and accessories-as-sculpture. Confident complementary blocks celebrate the many versions of you.
headline: Every side
is your good side.
features: Mix it your way
A little collection with a lot of possible combinations.
Express more
Objects chosen for how they make your world feel.
No single version
Room for the changing, interesting person you already are.
system.layoutNote: Violet split hero with limeade display type and a large constellation of differently scaled orbs. Alternate hard color blocks with round product frames.

brands.name: RASTER
brands.description: A digital-first identity for a motion and code studio. A broken pixel diamond, cold neutrals, and a flicker of acid green create an unmistakable computational character.
brands.heading: space-grotesk
rules: Pixel shapes snap to a square grid without rounded corners.
Use phosphor to identify one focal point per composition.
Set captions as compact mono data labels at the canvas edges.

system.concept: Dithered dimensional objects, scanner-like framing, broken grid glyphs, and compact machine labels. A digital visual world with an intentionally crafted edge.
headline: A sharper view.
A different resolution.
features: Design in detail
A visual practice that finds character in the smallest units.
Built with code
Experimental systems that are also ready for the real world.
A moving point of view
Work that keeps an idea clear across frames and formats.
system.layoutNote: Carbon hero, phosphor type, dithered artifact, and scan-line boundaries. Square pixels and mono captions; a strict data grid anchors experimental imagery.

brands.name: Commonroom

system.concept: Overlapping civic tickets, a communal-table emblem, bold blue notices, and deeply human editorial type. The information feels public, legible, and worth showing up for.
headline: Come on in.
There is room.
system.productNote: A shared space for different people.
features: A space to meet
A useful neighborhood place for conversation and new connections.
Something to be part of
A thoughtful program that welcomes different interests.
Bring your own voice
A community gets better when more perspectives can be heard.

brands.name: Caravan

Frame display headlines with badge-like rules and a small route label.
Use roadside teal sparingly against the warm main palette.

system.concept: Winding route illustrations, old road-sign geometry, stitched-looking badge frames, and sturdy condensed lettering. A practical travel world with a richly nostalgic landscape.
headline: Take the long way.
Bring good company.
system.eyebrow: GOODS FOR THE ROAD / NOTES FROM THE WAY
features: Useful on the way
A focused set of things that make a journey feel easier.
Routes worth the time
Notes for taking a more curious road.
Keep going, well
Practical design with the warmth of a familiar companion.

brands.name: Halcyon
brands.description: A contemplative identity for a restorative retreat. Concentric rings, pale rose, and finely drawn serif typography create a visual pause in an otherwise noisy world.

Use stillness for the majority of every canvas.
Leave at least one-third of each composition free of content.

system.concept: Concentric pools of light, delicate layered arches, low-relief paper texture, and exceptionally spacious serif typography. The system makes a visual pause tangible.
headline: The art of
a little stillness.
features: An unhurried beginning
Thoughtful spaces that give you room to settle.
A softer rhythm
Small practices for making more room in the day.
Return feeling present
A restorative experience with no need to rush the moment.
system.layoutNote: Stillness-white centered serif hero with an inset pool image and at least one-third open space. Fine driftwood rules and unobtrusive pill controls.

brands.name: MONUMENT
brands.description: A solid identity for an urban design practice. Stacked concrete-like blocks and wide black typography create presence through proportion rather than ornament.
brands.heading: unbounded

Use a visible structural grid and thick section rules.
Keep copper confined to identifiers or a single small module.

system.concept: Weighty isometric concrete sculptures, exposed construction grids, and aggressively clear expanded type. Proportion gives the identity its presence.
headline: Built on
something substantial.
features: A structural point of view
A practice that begins with what a place needs to become.
Material with meaning
Form and construction that remain visible and honest.
A lasting presence
Measured decisions with room for a building to age well.
system.layoutNote: Concrete-grey hero, broad black display, large monolith study, and thick horizontal rules. Copper only marks project numbers; project information stays aligned.

brands.name: nori

Fresh perspective.

A bright menu that starts with the good things in season.
Nothing out of place
Simple combinations with a considered balance.
A better little lunch
Food for the everyday that still feels like a small pleasure.

brands.name: tandem
brands.description: A balanced identity for a shared-mobility platform. Two linked loops, a clean teal, and functional typography express connection through the simplest possible geometry.

Keep interface spacing on a four-unit rhythm.
Use petrol text on porcelain for route and journey information.

headline: A better way
to move together.

A useful way to connect people going somewhere similar.
A clear next step
Thoughtful route information and simple journey planning.
Go a little further
A cooperative approach to moving through the everyday.

brands.description: A friendly identity for a habit-building app. Irregular rounded stones, clear cornflower blue, and an expressive but readable wordmark make progress feel human.

Keep encouraging headlines short and in lowercase.

A softer day.

A thoughtful beginning that can fit into your actual day.
Make it your rhythm
A gentle approach to building something consistent.
Notice the good
Small progress, clearly seen and kindly celebrated.

brands.name: PHASE

Use dark mode as the dominant developer-facing background.
Highlight a single transition with ion instead of adding gradients.

A practical structure for getting from an idea to its next version.
Tools with purpose
Useful primitives and fewer unnecessary choices.

A foundation that supports iteration rather than getting in its way.

brands.name: Almanac
brands.description: A thoughtful identity for an independent culture journal. An open-book emblem, deeply inked green, and index-like labels bring a sense of discovery to long-form stories.

Use issue numbers and running headers as integral design elements.
Combine serif titles with sans-serif paragraphs and mono-style metadata.

system.concept: Layered page objects, specimen-like illustrations, chapter rhythms, and richly readable book typography. A contemporary cultural journal that looks worth keeping.
headline: Look a little closer.

Thoughtful records of things that can too easily go unnoticed.
Keep the interesting parts
A considered archive of people, places, and perspectives.
Return to the page
Work with enough care and character to invite another reading.

brands.name: mellow

Keep backgrounds warm and use mulberry to anchor the composition.
Set short, chunky headlines with tight spacing and spacious supporting copy.

system.concept: Rounded sunburst ceramics, grooved color bands, hand-friendly shapes, and delightfully plump serif lettering. Nostalgia becomes an optimistic, useful everyday system.
headline: Good days.
At your own pace.
system.productNote: Make yourself a little more at home.
features: A warm beginning
Everyday objects with a generous, easygoing personality.
The soft details
Form and texture that make a place feel more like yours.
Take it your way
A collection that leaves room for your own rhythm.

brands.name: Atelier No.8

brands.description: A precise identity for a collectible-object atelier. A faceted diamond, antique mauve, and high-contrast serif lettering lend small editions a sense of enduring value.
brands.heading: cormorant
rules: Keep diamond facets outlined at a consistent weight.
Use edition numbers and object dimensions as deliberate typographic details.

Objects whose personality can outlast the first impression.

brands.name: terra

Material with a memory

Thoughtful decisions for the way a place will be lived in.
